selectFirst.where: Manage > Templates: error toast when Import from Setlist is pressed with no template chosen

untitledSetlist.where: Manage > Templates > Import from Setlist picker: name shown for a setlist with no name

fetchSetlistsFailed.where: Manage > Templates: error toast when the setlist picker can't load

loadTracksFailed.where: Manage > Templates: error toast when the chosen setlist's songs can't be read

imported.where: Manage > Templates: toast after importing a setlist into a template
imported.context: {count} is a number of template slots (rows), {setlistName} is the setlist's name. English uses 'slots' for every count; Hebrew may add plural variants (imported_one/_two/_other).

loading.where: Manage > Templates: Import button while the setlist list loads

importFromSetlist.where: Manage > Templates: button above the editor, and the picker dialog title

regularServices.where: Manage > Templates: sidebar group heading (CSS uppercase)
regularServices.context: Weekly services, as opposed to holidays

holidayServices.where: Manage > Templates: sidebar group heading (CSS uppercase)

selectToEdit.where: Manage > Templates: empty editor area before a template is chosen

importPickerHint.where: Manage > Templates > Import from Setlist dialog: instruction
importPickerHint.context: {templateLabel} is the service template's name (e.g. 'Shabbat Morning'); keep the quotation marks around it in your language's style

noSetlists.where: Manage > Templates > Import from Setlist dialog: empty state

trackCount.where: Manage > Templates > Import from Setlist dialog: under each setlist's name, optionally followed by ' · <date>'
trackCount.context: {count} is a number of songs. English uses one form for all counts; Hebrew may add plural variants.

cancel.where: Manage > Templates > Import from Setlist dialog: close button

customBadge.where: Manage > Templates: small badge on a template that was edited from the default

slotCount.where: Manage > Templates: sidebar line under each template's name
slotCount.context: {count} is a number of rows in the template. English uses one form for all counts; Hebrew may add plural variants.
